title: Basis of the Switch Down Payment by Invoicing Progress — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Rule.** For a move of a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** billing an Owner Auto Policy term off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, the basis of the switch down payment depends on how far the term has been invoiced. The installments not yet invoiced are the plan's number of installments less the installment invoices already issued.

| Invoicing progress | Basis |
|---|---|
| at least one installment invoiced and two or more not yet invoiced | the down payment percentage is applied to the scheduled premium not yet invoiced, and nothing is taken off it |
| only one installment not yet invoiced | no switch down payment is taken |
| no installment invoiced yet, or none left to invoice | the down payment percentage is applied to the full-term premium billed, divided by 100, less the plan's own down payment premium |

The scheduled premium not yet invoiced is the full-term premium billed less the plan's own down payment premium and less the scheduled installment premium once for each installment already invoiced; the plan's own down payment premium is its recorded down payment amount less the fully earned fees it took.

**Hypothetical cases (five-installment plan, down payment percentage 20)**

- Two invoices issued, scheduled premium not yet invoiced 650.00: 20 percent of 650.00, which is 130.00, nothing taken off.
- Four invoices issued: one installment left, no switch down payment.
- No invoice issued, full-term premium billed 1,300.00, own down payment premium 221.00: 260.00 less 221.00, which is 39.00.
